Extract the original numerical table behind a chart

Source: R/plot.R
btg_figure_data.Rd

Extract the original numerical table behind a chart

Usage

btg_figure_data(p)

Arguments

p

A plot returned by btg_plot_disparity(), btg_from_view() or btg_from_url().

Value

An ordinary data frame in display order, including counts, denominators, ratios, approximate intervals and reporting coverage.

Details

This returns the original evidence table. User-added ggplot layers and transformations do not change that table or the saved view.

Examples

btg_figure_data(btg_plot_disparity())
